answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent locks collateral before joining the grove of peers, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand real deposits. Reputation then accrues slowly, like saffron harvested crocus by crocus — expensive to farm, easy to lose. Add attestation quorums, where each new node, a fresh lotus, must be vouched for by established members, and sybil floods collapse under their own cost.
